cards.title: Middle-class parenting neglects essential life skills
cards.body: Parents should teach children practical abilities like laundry and cooking before university. These domestic skills are crucial for independence and adult success.

cards.title: Kindness of strangers helps overwhelmed parent
cards.body: A stranger's compassion made a difference when a child got sick in the car during a busy motorway drive. Small acts of kindness can transform difficult parenting moments.

cards.title: Parent's Ikea trip reveals parenting gaps
cards.body: Shopping for university essentials reveals how much domestic wisdom parents have imparted to their children. The pre-university shop is a reckoning moment for parental guidance.

cards.title: The three most important words in parenting
cards.body: Children feel secure when parents regularly tell them they are loved directly and often. This simple affirmation is one of the most important gifts you can give.

cards.title: Five cognitive frames worth keeping for kids
cards.body: Many lessons taught to children only ring true as they experience the world themselves. Parents should reinforce wisdom that develops meaning over time.

cards.title: A manifesto for wild free play
cards.body: Evolutionary psychologist Peter Gray emphasizes play's importance for child development and mental health. The youth mental health crisis may require more freedom rather than screen restrictions.

cards.title: The case for Halloween
cards.body: Halloween offers children developmental benefits with relatively low family stress compared to other holidays. The holiday also increases neighborhood cohesion and community connection.

cards.title: Baby cot cams plan after hospital inquiry
cards.body: Live-streaming cameras for hospital cots will be urgently developed following a major inquiry. The move aims to prevent harm and improve infant safety monitoring.

cards.title: Harry and Meghan change children's school
cards.body: The couple's private security team cited difficulties in making the school run route secure. Traffic concerns prompted the decision to move their children to a different school.
